text:
anya (product): quick thread  Anchor customer (FinGate) asks for a pricing floor + short-term elastic lease for peak payroll windows. They want guaranteed tokens/min for payroll routes, explicit overage pricing, and a way to opt into "no-preempt" for a fee. Need to scope before next planning.

sam (eng-platform): implementation options: (A) create ephemeral lease objects that map to existing reserved pools (fast), or (B) materialize separate short-lived dedicated pools (heavy). Leaning to ephemeral leases tagged into the scheduler.

mike (finance): pricing floor means minimum monthly charge for the lease + metered overage. We need exportable per-lease usage (route, window, tokens) and dispute window. Also propose a 25% premium for no-preempt days.

priya (eng-sre): ops concerns: transient leases increase scheduling complexity. Need deterministic preemption ordering and a kill-switch. Recommend default fallback order: queue (50ms) -> fallback model -> reject with clear 429 reason.

zoe (customer-success): FinGate will accept ephemeral leases if onboarding shows clear calendar controls and invoice previews. Also asked for sample SLA clause for missed guaranteed minutes.

anya (product): action list: 1) eng to estimate ephemeral lease plumbing + telemetry export, 2) finance to draft invoice schema and surcharge numbers, 3) cs to validate acceptance criteria with FinGate. Decision checkpoint: Fri 17:00.

sam (eng-platform): rough estimate: 4-6d to add lease metadata + routing tags, 2d for billing export hooks, 2d for dashboard panels and alerts. ~8-10d total. Can prototype in sandbox.

priya (eng-sre): gating for pilot: export working, rollback toggle, preemption audit logs, and basic invoice reconciliation test. Ops will need 48h oncall during pilot.

mike (finance): I'll draft invoice line: "Elastic lease (route payroll/*): monthly floor $M; guaranteed N tokens/min during scheduled windows; excess billed at $Y per 1k tokens; no-preempt surcharge Z%." Will circulate.

anya (product): thanks. I'll create an epic and assign estimates. Keep pilot minimal: one lease, two routes, one month retention for logs.
